title: 黄仁勋之后：13年CFO临时接棒，首场财报电话会能稳住吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: A video to your financial officer, Collette Cress, has largely stayed out of the spotlight.
segments.zh: 一段关于首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯的视频，她一直较为低调。

segments.en: During her 13 years at the company, now, as Interim CEO, she's been for us center stage.
segments.zh: 在公司任职13年，如今作为临时CEO，她为我们走到了聚光灯下。

segments.en: As Nvidia navigates, it's biggest leadership crisis.
segments.zh: 英伟达正经历其最大的领导层变动。

segments.en: Boombas needed Trentman, joins us with Maureen, a lot of writing that you've done in the last 24 hours.
segments.zh: Boomba's needed Trentman，与Maureen一起加入我们，你过去24小时写了很多。

segments.en: Introduce our audience if they're not familiar with Collette Cress to her and her history, but also the role she's now playing.
segments.zh: 向观众介绍科莱特·克雷斯，如果还不熟悉的话，以及她的历史和现在的角色。

segments.en: Yeah, happy to. As you pointed out, Collette Cress has been with the company for the past 13 years.
segments.zh: 好的，乐意。如你所说，科莱特·克雷斯过去13年一直在公司。

segments.en: She joined as executive vice president and CFO and has held this role ever since.
segments.zh: 她以执行副总裁兼CFO身份加入，此后一直担任该职。

segments.en: She previously worked at Cisco, Microsoft, and Texas Instruments, always in finance roles.
segments.zh: 她此前在思科、微软和德州仪器工作，始终从事财务岗位。

segments.en: And of course, the interesting thing is that the company she joined in 2013 is a very different company to the one that we know today.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，她2013年加入时的公司与今天截然不同。

segments.en: Nvidia has involved from being a company focused on chips, largely used for computer gaming to this huge machine of the AI trade.
segments.zh: 英伟达从一家专注于芯片、主要用于电脑游戏的公司，转型为AI领域的巨头。

segments.en: And so, of course, with that, also grew the role that she's had.
segments.zh: 因此，她的角色自然也随着公司发展而扩大。

segments.en: At the same time, also, of course, she was the CFO to Jensen Huang.
segments.zh: 同时，她也是黄仁勋的财务主管。

segments.en: So she hasn't necessarily played as much of a public facing role as other CFOs at companies of that size as you would imagine.
segments.zh: 所以，她并不像同等规模公司的其他财务主管那样频繁出现在公众面前。

segments.en: It's so interesting the decision to name her CEO on Interim basis.
segments.zh: 任命她为临时首席执行官的决定非常有趣。

segments.en: I'll never forget a conversation I had with her in August, 2025.
segments.zh: 我永远不会忘记2025年8月与她的那次对话。

segments.en: The idea at the time was about Nvidia sharing revenue with the US government.
segments.zh: 当时的话题是关于英伟达与美国政府分享收入。
